_doc: Green Profits is a SCENARIO calculator, not a trained model. No take-up model is trained on synthetic labels (problem statement section 9). Take-up comes from the documented rule below; every coefficient is an explicit assumption shown as a slider and labelled as such. Results are Monte Carlo ranges over the slider ranges. Replace with an estimated model only if real take-up data becomes available.

take_up_rule.form: p_take_up = sigmoid(b0 + b1*(improvement_potential_pct/10) + b2*ln(1 + annual_bill_saving_gbp/100) + b3*owner_occupier + b4*((deprivation_decile - 5)/5))
take_up_rule.rationale: Directional assumptions only: higher potential and savings, owner-occupation and lower deprivation are expected to raise take-up. Magnitudes are not estimated from data.

profit_terms.lending: loan_balance x net_interest_margin x term_years (discounted) + fees
profit_terms.all_parameters: sliders with stated ranges; status = assumption

label: Illustrative scenario on a synthetic customer base. Not a forecast.
